with source as (
    select * from public.raw_space_missions
),

cleaned as (
    select
        mission                                         as mission_name,
        company,
        rocket,
        location,
        country,
        date::date                                      as launch_date,
        year::int                                       as launch_year,
        decade::int                                     as launch_decade,
        rocketstatus                                    as rocket_status,
        missionstatus                                   as mission_status,
        price                                           as cost_usd_millions,
        case
            when missionstatus = 'Success' then true
            else false
        end                                             as is_success,
        case
            when company in (
                'SpaceX', 'Rocket Lab', 'Blue Origin',
                'Virgin Orbit', 'Arianespace', 'ULA'
            ) then 'Commercial'
            else 'Government'
        end                                             as sector
    from source
    where date is not null
)

select * from cleaned

with missions as (
    select * from "postgres"."analytics_staging"."stg_missions"
),

agency_stats as (
    select
        company,
        sector,
        count(*)                                            as total_launches,
        sum(case when is_success then 1 else 0 end)         as successful_launches,
        round(
            sum(case when is_success then 1 else 0 end)::numeric
            / count(*) * 100, 1
        )                                                   as success_rate_pct,
        min(launch_year)                                    as first_launch_year,
        max(launch_year)                                    as last_launch_year,
        round(avg(cost_usd_millions)::numeric, 2)           as avg_cost_usd_millions
    from missions
    group by company, sector
)

select * from agency_stats
order by total_launches desc

with missions as (
    select * from "postgres"."analytics_staging"."stg_missions"
)

select

    sector,

    round(

from missions
group by launch_year, sector

    count(*)                                            as total_launches,
    sum(case when is_success then 1 else 0 end)         as successful_launches,
